# Database Connection Troubleshooting

This runbook provides step-by-step procedures for diagnosing and resolving database connection issues in production environments.

## Common Symptoms
- Connection timeouts
- Authentication failures
- Too many connections errors
- Intermittent connectivity issues

## Prerequisites
Ensure you have the necessary access and tools before proceeding with troubleshooting.

## Troubleshooting Procedures
Follow these steps systematically to identify and resolve database connection issues.

structured_sections.overview: Comprehensive guide for troubleshooting database connectivity issues
